assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: borderless square MMORPG aura icon for World of ClaudeCraft
Primary request: create one fresh, distinct, premium hand-painted dark-fantasy MMORPG aura painting for Battle Elixir Vigor (runtime identity elixir_buff_sta).
Canonical mechanic: drinking any of four battle elixirs grants a long-duration Stamina increase. The same runtime aura identity deliberately represents Bear, Boar, Vipersear, and Serpent elixirs, so the painting must communicate neutral alchemical endurance without depicting one animal family.
Input images: Image 1 is the warm amber bottle and tactile glass reference; Image 2 is the green higher-tier alchemy palette and dark atmospheric finish reference; Image 3 is the broad-body fortitude and strong small-icon value structure reference. Create a new composition and do not copy their exact subjects.
Scene/backdrop: fully opaque full-square soot-black and deep umber painted atmosphere, restrained amber and emerald alchemical haze.
Subject: one heavy dark-bronze anatomical heart made sturdy and whole, with broad hammered plates rather than gore, rising from a single small open alchemical flask. Two thick ribbons of amber and emerald vapor wrap upward around the heart without forming a badge or complete ring. The heart must read as stamina and enduring vigor, while the flask and mixed vapor make the shared elixir source unmistakable.
Composition/framing: one dominant centered heart and flask silhouette, fills about 82 percent with safe margins, broad value groups, crisp focal edges, readable at 16, 28, 32, 40, and 48 pixels.
Lighting/mood: warm top-left amber key, cool emerald underlight from the flask, deep values, controlled saturation, resilient and empowering rather than healing.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted classic fantasy MMORPG ability and aura art, tactile bronze and glass, soft atmospheric periphery, no flat vector treatment.
Constraints: opaque square; one heart, one flask, two vapor ribbons; no text, letters, numbers, runes, UI frame, border, badge, rarity chrome, watermark, logo, medical cross, shield, full character, animal head, bear, boar, snake, viper, blood, gore, photorealism, modern graphic design, or accidental writing.
assets.decision: Accepted after source and 128/48/32/16 plus 16px grayscale review.
